name: @vj/engine
description: Sandbox execution engine: given a language, source, stdin and limits, run it in a locked-down Docker container and report stdout/stderr/exit/timing. Knows nothing about problems, test cases, grading, the queue or the database.

scripts.test: ts-node test/outcomes.test.ts && ts-node test/run-once.test.ts && ts-node test/tle.test.ts && ts-node test/limits.test.ts
